text:
alex: Heads-up — HyperLedgerBank POC kicks off Mon. They require SAML SSO + SCIM user/group sync + delegated RBAC. Security team flagged domain-proofing and session-replay controls. Anyone free to scope integration? 

maria_g: I can lead. Do we know their IdP (Okta/AzureAD/OneLogin)? Need SP metadata, ACS URL, default NameID format. Also: do they want username or email as SCIM id? 

jordan_m: Pricing note — baseline POC estimate = 2 small dedicated slots + burst on demand. SCIM heavy sync (>5000 users initial) adds data-transfer and rate-limiting overhead. I'll DM a quick cost table. 

samira: Security checklist from legal: KMS for token encryption, 1yr audit log retention, attestations for SAML assertions, and domain-verification proof. They might request Private deployment (VPC). 

sec-bot: SECURITY-QUESTIONNAIRE (received 2026-03-18): status = 75% complete. Missing answers: "domain ownership verification flow" and "SCIM delta handling / throttling strategy". Link: https://redwood.example/sq/HLB-827

alex: Quick clarifications — we support DNS TXT or CNAME domain proofing, and can accept SAML-assertion-based ownership. For SCIM, we provide delta + bulk endpoints and adaptive backoff. Example SCIM headers we return for throttling: Retry-After, X-RateLimit-Remaining. 

maria_g: Paste for ops:
```
SCIM config:
{
  "base_url": "https://idp.scim.hyperledgerbank.com/v2",
  "batch_size": 200,
  "delta_enabled": true,
  "retry_after_header": true
}
```

maria_g: For SAML SP metadata, send ACS + EntityID, we'll return our metadata. Example ACS: https://redwood.example/saml/acs/hlb

jordan_m: To unblock commercial: propose 30-day POC pricing (credit applied) then scale plan if they hit >50k tokens/day. If they require Private, quote moves to annual enterprise license. 

samira: I'll own security questionnaire answers for the two missing items. Can you share the contact in their security team, @alex? 

alex: cc: @samira — contact is emma.collins@hlb.com. Emma requested a short demo on Wed. Can we set a 30-min SAML+SCIM walkthrough Tues 11am PT? :calendar:

maria_g: Works for me. I'll prepare a short checklist for the call and a sample SAML metadata file to share beforehand. :thumbsup:

jordan_m: I'll include the provisional POC quote in the calendar invite. 

samira: I'll attach the partial SQ and the two prepared answers to the event. 

alex: Thanks — we'll aim to close POC scope this week. :rocket:
